params.prompt: A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a welding shop's contact page where the biggest element is a photo drop zone: a large dark steel frame with a dashed teal-blue outline and the words "Drop a photo of the job", beside three short fields (Name, Phone, Where is it?) and a teal-blue button "Send the request". The attached chrome emblem sits in the dark header with the number 425-283-6496. Background: a dark welding shop, out of focus, a hint of a workbench. Heading "Tell me about the job". Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no pastels.
